modules.title: Introduction to Indices, Logarithms and Surds (Advanced)
modules.html:
Laws of indices and logarithms, and equations involving surds. This section covers introduction to indices, logarithms and surds (advanced).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of indices, logarithms and surds (advanced).
  • Be able to explain indices, logarithms and surds (advanced) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Find the sum of the first 8 terms of the GP: $2, 6, 18, ...$
A: 6560 — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: 6560.

Q: If $$ z = 3 + 4i $$, find $$ |z| $$.
A: 5 — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 5.
